items.title: Randy Sandke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: He has become one of the most in-demand trumpeters working today, appearing with Jon Hendricks, Benny Carter, Kenny Davern, Mel Torme and many others.

ctx.x: Randy Sandke was born in Chicago in 1949 and was introduced to jazz by his trumpet playing older brother. After a ten year period where he concentrated on guitar, Randy returned to the trumpet and established himself in the New York City jazz scene of the 1970s. He has become one of the most in-demand trumpeters working today, appearing with Jon Hendricks, Benny Carter, Kenny Davern, Mel Torme and many others. Randy was interviewed at the Jerome Jazz Party in Aspen, Colorado on October 10, 1997, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
